description: Create a `yield` job: make a resource from a gathered context. It names no resource of its own: the job is about the resource its context focuses on, which the Dispatcher reads from `params.context.focus`.

_userId.description: The emitter's verified DID, injected by the gateway. Clients do not set this.

_roles.description: The emitter's roles, injected by the gateway when it has any. Clients do not set this.
